name: assert_python_failure
doc: Assert that running the interpreter with args and optional environment variables env_vars fails (rc != 0) and return a (return code, stdout, stderr) tuple.

changed.text: The function no longer strips whitespaces from stderr.

name: assert_python_ok
doc: Assert that running the interpreter with args and optional environment variables env_vars succeeds (rc == 0) and return a (return code, stdout, stderr) tuple.

changed.text: The function no longer strips whitespaces from stderr.

name: interpreter_requires_environment
doc: Return True if sys.executable interpreter requires environment variables in order to be able to run at all.

name: kill_python
doc: Run the given subprocess.Popen process until completion and return stdout.

name: make_pkg
doc: Create a directory named pkg_dir containing an __init__ file with init_source as its contents.

name: make_script
doc: Create script containing source in path script_dir and script_basename. If omit_suffix is False, append .py to the name. Return the full script path.

name: make_zip_pkg
signatures: make_zip_pkg(zip_dir, zip_basename, pkg_name, script_basename, source, depth=1, compiled=False)
doc: Create a zip package directory with a path of zip_dir and zip_basename containing an empty __init__ file and a file script_basename containing the source. If compiled is True, both source files will be compiled and added to the zip package. Return a tuple of the full zip path and the archive name for the zip file.

name: make_zip_script
doc: Create zip file at zip_dir and zip_basename with extension zip which contains the files in script_name. name_in_zip is the archive name. Return a tuple containing (full path, full path of archive name).

name: run_python_until_end
doc: Set up the environment based on env_vars for running the interpreter in a subprocess. The values can include __isolated, __cleanenv, __cwd, and TERM.

changed.text: The function no longer strips whitespaces from stderr.

name: spawn_python
doc: Run a Python subprocess with the given arguments.
